remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502 -DWINVER=0x502)

add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0600
    -DWINVER=0x0600)

include_directories(
    BEFORE
    ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/wine
    ${REACTOS_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/include/wine)

spec2def(d3dx10_43.dll d3dx10_43.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# d3dx10_43.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/d3dx10_43-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(d3dx10_43_shims OBJECT async.c compiler.c d3dx10_43_main.c font.c mesh.c sprite.c texture.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(d3dx10_43_shims PRIVATE wine dxguid dx10guid uuid libd3d10_1 libd3dcompiler_47 libd3dx9_36 libgdi32 libkernel32_vista libntdll_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
add_dependencies(d3dx10_43_shims wineheaders d3d_idl_headers)
add_cargo_module(d3dx10_43 d3dx10_43-cargo d3dx10_43.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS d3dx10_43_shims psdk d3d_idl_headers uuid_sources)
